title: Allegations of Being the Mastermind
text: “Even so, I still can’t believe this story about Motoyasu coming from the future,”
Ren said in his usual tone. Well, it’s actually pretty rare for Ren and Itsuki to believe what I say.
“Why is that?”

“He’s meddling way too much. A national conspiracy? Then why didn’t he just leave the country sooner instead of dragging his feet? There were plenty of other things he could have done. He could have exposed the government’s conspiracy, sought asylum in another country before things got out of hand—there are plenty of options.”
“I mentioned that before, didn’t I? It’s because that would lead to war. Melromarc was getting too cocky after acquiring a Hero other than my Father.”
“Motoyasu’s way of putting it is a bit off, so the two of you have misunderstood, but Motoyasu is stuck in a loop… he’s been repeating this world several times.”
Hmm… It seems my poor explanation has caused my Father some trouble. Well then, I’ll follow Father’s example and answer every question I’m asked.
“That’s right. I’ve already looped through this world several times and am here now.”
“And, it seems things are all rather complicated and difficult, so my knowledge is a bit lacking. In fact, I didn’t even know the name of the inn where I stayed on my first day of adventure.”
“I was asked that, too.”
“I haven’t been asked, though. Does that mean Motoyasu-san thinks I’m unimportant?”
“It’s true—I haven’t heard anything from Itsuki. Since this is a good opportunity, I’d like you to tell me.”
“No way!”
I’ve been turned down. Still, it would be better to know that information. However, I don’t think Itsuki would willingly tell me right now. Oh well. I guess I’ll just have to give up.
“Well then, if there’s a next time, I’ll just have to stalk Itsuki to find out where he stayed.”
“Ugh… Please stop. That’s creepy!”
“If you’ve got nothing to hide, you might as well just tell me. You seem to be convinced of that, anyway.”
“Sigh… I guess I have no choice.”

Saying that, Itsuki told me where he’d been staying. But Itsuki’s a master at lying, you know. He might have given me a fake address. In the next loop, I’ll make a point of stalking Itsuki. For the first two days, as long as I don’t make contact with my Father, I’ll have relatively free rein. The stalking techniques I picked up from those bastards who killed me will come in handy!

“To begin with, there’s only so much information a single person can know. Even Motoyasu isn’t a god, after all. With three of us, there’s bound to be some information we don’t all share. Besides, ‘you can’t have your cake and eat it too’ is a classic trope in loop stories.”
“Hmph, I don’t think so. That’s exactly the kind of thing a con artist would say.”
“I think a con artist who insists we’re in a loop has no talent…”
“You can spout all the smooth talk you want, but I won’t be fooled.”

It seems neither Ren nor Itsuki believes a word I’m saying. But Itsuki, isn’t it precisely because you were fooled by the Three Heroes Church’s smooth talk that you’re in this situation now? … I could tell them right now that the loop started when Itsuki was killed by his own party last time, but there’s a high chance they wouldn’t believe me—and the conversation wouldn’t go anywhere. It’s a hassle, so I’ll just keep that to myself.

“So, you’re probably going to say something like, ‘It’s because you put into practice the enhancement method Naofumi explained before,’ right? Like I said before, I told you that mine can’t be enhanced because each Hero’s weapon has different specifications.”
“So, are you saying that Ren’s weapon is a inferior version, far weaker than mine?”
“What!? Of course my weapon is the strongest! In fact, it’s the strongest weapon in *Brave Star Online*, the game this world is based on!”
“What are you talking about! The game this world is based on is *Dimension Wave*! A bow is obviously stronger than a sword—a weak weapon with no advantages other than being able to equip a shield!”
“A bow is the strongest? Ha! It’s not even as good as Magic.”
“It’s the strongest weapon—it has penetration, high damage per second, and even supports the Flight attribute.”
“What are you talking about? Swords deal more damage and are far more versatile. Bows have issues with firepower. Besides, if you equip a shield, your evasion and attack speed drop. I don’t get it.”

Ren and Itsuki have started debating which weapon is the strongest. Well, since we’re heroes and can’t equip anything other than specific weapons, Ren can’t actually equip a shield. I’m sure they’re just talking about a game he used to play. Oh? My Father looks puzzled.
“Hey? Isn’t there a discrepancy in your game knowledge?”
Did my Father notice that? Well, I did mention it before.

I, too, used to believe that the spear was the strongest weapon in the first world. In terms of attack range, attack speed, power, versatility… it ranked at the top in every category. In Emerald Online, where you can craft specialized weapons, it’s an absolutely perfect match. Well, turns out I was wrong, though.
“That’s why I’ve been saying all along that the specs differ from game to game! That’s reflected in the weapons!”
“I see. So Motoyasu’s weapon had cheat-level performance from the very beginning! You cheater! I can’t even believe you came from the future! You were the mastermind behind it all, weren’t you!”
“So that’s how it is! If Motoyasu really is the mastermind, that explains everything.”
“Calm down! What would I gain by deceiving Ren and Itsuki?”
Father says this as if to soothe Ren and Itsuki. Still, so they’ve come to accuse me of being the mastermind. If that were the case, things would be a lot easier for me.

Just as Father said, there’s nothing to be gained by deceiving Itsuki or Ren. These guys really overestimate themselves. I’m just stronger than most people because my level and weapons have been enhanced.

“Naofumi, just because Motoyasu helped you doesn’t mean you should blindly trust him—you’ll end up getting hurt. There’s actually a possibility that one of the heroes is the mastermind behind it all, and is trying to get the hero who owes him a debt of gratitude to rule the world in his place…”
“Motoyasu?”
My father stares at me. I smiled back at him.
“See! I just gave you a little hint!”
That’s funny. I was trying to show him with my smile that I wasn’t thinking that way, but he ended up being even more convinced.

“No, that can’t be… That’s totally the face of someone who isn’t thinking about anything at all. Do you know what Motoyasu usually does? When I’m not asking him for favors, he’s just hanging out with Yuki-chan and the others—the Filolials—all the time, you know?”
“That’s just an act! And then, seizing the moment, he’ll reveal his true colors and kill Naofumi-san.”
“I don’t think that’ll happen. It’d be way harder to keep Motoyasu-kun under control… Besides, it’d be unnatural for the mastermind to go through all this trouble.”
“Either way, I’ve heard from rumors that Motoyasu is somewhat strong, but we know there’s a limit to that, right?”
Come to think of it, I’ve never actually shown Ren that. Well, Itsuki probably understands, since he’s seen him wipe out a party in an instant and beat people to a pulp.
“He’s definitely strong as a monster! I couldn’t even put up a fight!”
“That’s because you’re weak, Itsuki. You can’t even beat Naofumi, a tank.”
“I’m not weak at all! What’s this?! Are you trying to make fun of me too, Ren-san?!”
“I’m just stating the facts. Itsuki, you’re weak.”
“What did you say! There’s no way I’m weak! Isn’t Ren-san—who lost to a girl and is all talk—the one who’s weak?”
“What did you say!?”
“Want to settle this with a duel?”
“Sword Hero, Bow Hero, please calm down!”
My fiancée is trying to stop Ren and Itsuki, who are seriously about to get into a fight. Oh well. If Ren says he wants to know me, I’ll show him what I’m really made of.
“Shall I demonstrate, then?”
“Motoyasu-kun, what are you going to do?”
“Well, I’d like you to watch.”
I stand up and open the window. The night sea stretches out before us, visible from this castle-like hotel. There, I focus my mind and weave magic.

“I, The Love Hunter, command the heavens and the earth; I sever and reconnect the order of things, and force out the pus. O power of the Dragon Vein! Unite with my Magical Power and the strength of the hero to form a single force. The Love Hunter, the source of all power, commands: Decipher all things in the universe once more, and bring forth a false sun!”
“Liberation Prominence X!”

A ball of flame materialized in my hand. Then I hurled it with all my might out the window. The ball of flame flew straight ahead, past the tip of the island… beyond the coastline and out into the sea, where it exploded like fireworks. It created another sun on the horizon.
“Wh—”
“Wh… w-what… that can’t be…”
“How about that?”
“I see. You’re right—showing it in action really is the quickest way to prove it.”

Only Ren and Itsuki stared up at the sky, looking dumbfounded. Father and my Finacée have both seen Liberation-type Magic before, after all. The new sun continued to shine brilliantly on the horizon for several minutes. Peering out the window, I could see the island’s residents had noticed what was happening outside and were starting to murmur and stir.
“Just think of that as Motoyasu’s show-off magic. You can imagine what would happen if he went all out, right?”

I suppose this should have made my strength clear to them by now. Come to think of it, I’d only been using relatively low-key Skills in front of Ren and Itsuki. My reason for doing so was that if I drew too much attention, things might not go according to history—but there’s no need to be on guard anymore. In fact, I have to make sure things don’t go according to history.
“W-well, even if I take that with a grain of salt, that’s the reason Motoyasu is unnaturally strong, huh…”
“It’s because I came from the future. I know not only how to enhance Ren and Itsuki, but also everything there is to know about every weapon.”
“Hmph. That’s exactly why I’m saying I can’t share how to enhance me or Itsuki. You’re just saying you were chosen by some weird weapon that makes you unnaturally strong! You coward!”
Aren’t Ren and Itsuki trying to force themselves to accept this? It was like this in the first world, including me, but they’re so hard to reason with that it makes me wonder if they’re even human.
“So what about me, then?”
My Father points at himself and says.
“Naofumi? Well, you’re putting up a good fight, but you’re just powering through with your level. There’s no way a shield class can be strong.”
“Listen…”
The Father looks exhausted. No wonder Ren and Itsuki are worn out with this.
“No, I managed to pull off the enhancement method Motoyasu-kun taught me, and I gained some formidable Defense Power…”

“It certainly seems tough, but does that actually make you strong? You can’t do anything if you just defend. I’ll break through your defense in no time. No, you don’t even need defense in the first place! Don’t you know there are attacks that pierce defense?”
What kind of contradictory nonsense is he spouting? It’s true that Father is solid. In fact, it would be difficult for me to break through his defense right now.

To begin with, my father is trying to learn countermeasures against penetration attacks. My father from the future had completely mastered this and was able to nullify them. This is an application of the Energy Boost technique.

Incidentally, my father from the future had mastered this nullification technique without relying on the Energy Boost’s bonuses. He mentioned something about it being an application of a certain school of thought. If you’re not careful, the penetration attack might even bounce right back at you.

But, sadly… Since my Father’s combat ability is entirely allocated to defense, he has no means of attack. Even with a shield capable of counterattacks, it’s difficult to instantly render an opponent incapacitated.

I believe he did once scorch me with a Curse Series shield, but the Curse Series comes with its fair share of risks. In fact, my Father has suffered life-threatening injuries several times, and he doesn’t currently possess any Curse Series shields.

That’s right—the only way to prove the Father’s strength is for him to endure. It’s certainly true that this makes it hard to demonstrate his strength in a way that’s visible to the eye. It’s truly difficult unless some kind of monster appears right before our eyes—one that Ren and Itsuki would be absolutely certain they couldn’t defeat.
“There’s no way I can do it but Ren and Itsuki can’t, right? At least hear me out. The method for enhancing Itsuki that I heard from Motoyasu—”

With that, my father desperately began explaining the enhancement method to Itsuki and Ren. By revealing an enhancement method that the two of them were keeping secret, he was trying to lend credibility to the idea that I’d come from the future. However, Ren and Itsuki didn’t budge an inch.
“Motoyasu’s enhancement method simply encompasses all other enhancement methods. No, it’s not even certain that there aren’t enhancement methods even Naofumi can’t use.”
“That’s impossible. I’ve heard that the abilities of the Four Holy Weapons are on the same level, even if their approaches differ. And I’ve experienced that firsthand.”
In fact, my Father has mastered every enhancement method I know, and I don’t think even I could defeat him now.
